summary: The maintenance screen of one master record (a customer, a product, a department): its fields in named groups, with the registration and the deletion.
not_for: A document with lines (entry.slip); the read-only view of a record (record.header with record.summary-list); a list of the records (collection.table.index).

slots.when: The record has more fields than one group reads well: the section's `groups` key names them.

rules.rule: The fields sit in named groups, the identifying ones first: the code and the name, then the address, then the terms.
A group is headed by a noun, and the groups keep one order on the create and on the edit screen.
The registration saves the record, and the deletion removes the record on the screen after its confirmation.
The actions of a register or an edit screen sit together at the foot: the registration first, the deletion last.
The saving word is the one the conventions give; without a profile it is the project's own.
The first field the reader fills takes the focus when the form opens.
A required field carries the mark the conventions give, and no other field carries a mark.

maps_to.shadcn: form, with FormField of the kit

evidence.source: 弥生販売 サポート情報, 得意先台帳の概要
evidence.says: The customer ledger screen is described in sections: 得意先情報 with the code and the name, 住所情報, 出力方法 and 取引条件. F9 deletes the customer shown.

evidence.source: Microsoft Learn, Business Central, Designing card and document pages
evidence.says: A card page holds one master record; FastTabs group its fields under a common heading, in an order the page defines.

evidence.source: OBC 奉行Jシリーズ 早わかり操作集, 部門を登録する
evidence.says: A department is registered by entering its code and name and pressing the [登録](F12) button, after a message that begins 登録します。よろしいですか.

evidence.source: intra-mart Accel Platform UIデザインガイドライン(PC版), ボタン
evidence.says: On a register or an edit screen the action buttons sit together at the foot, 登録 before 連続登録 and 更新 before 削除; the search button sits to the right of the input in the search-condition area.

evidence.source: intra-mart Accel Platform UIデザインガイドライン(PC版), 登録画面
evidence.says: The button of a register screen reads 登録 by default.

evidence.source: intra-mart Accel Platform UIデザインガイドライン(PC版), 入力フォーム
evidence.says: Numbers are right-aligned and strings and dates left-aligned in text inputs; the first input the user fills takes the focus, the search box of a search screen included.
